name: Nudity
overview: Scripture presents nudity initially as a state of innocence and freedom, exemplified by Adam and Eve who were naked without shame in the Garden of Eden. However, following the Fall, their awareness of nakedness brought fear and shame, prompting them to cover themselves with fig leaves and later, God provided garments of skin to clothe them. This shift highlights the spiritual and moral consequences of sin affecting human vulnerability and dignity. Additionally, the command in Exodus about not exposing nakedness at the altar underscores the importance of modesty and reverence in worship.
